message.content: {"verdict":"conflict","citations":["rbi-13155"],"confidence":0.95,"rationale":"RBI Directions (Commercial Banks – Credit Cards and Debit Cards: Issuance and Conduct) 2025/2026 prohibit issuing debit cards to cash credit/loan accounts (para 47) and mandate issuance only to savings/current accounts (para 46). The clause allowing debit cards on cash credit accounts contradicts these requirements."}
